tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bir+wa pa'i lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg las nyon sdig sgrib kun sel bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra bi dā rā ya/ rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma dang / /dbyer med rdo rje rnam 'joms la btud nas/ /dngos grub sgrub dang sdig pa zhi byed pa'i/ /sbyin sreg cho ga'i gsal byed bshad kyis nyon/ /bsnyen pa las su rung bar byas shing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad bskang ba dang / rang gi sdig pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ cho ga sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar las dang po thab ni/ nyams dga' zhing sa yi cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa la khru phyed kyi dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang / slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi'i rtse legs par sbrel bas stegs bu gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha ga gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni bri cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang / sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsung / thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba la 'khor lo'i lte ba dang sum gnyis lhag tsam la rtsibs bcu/ de'i 'phros la mu khyud gcig rnams bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar po bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zlum pa'i 'phreng bas bskor/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spang ba'i phyir/

bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/ lte ba dang rtsibs mu khyud rnams la tshom bu'am so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon spung bya/ de yang gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mdun rtsibs gnyis la steng dang shar gyi khro bo'i mtshan ma byas la/ de'i rigs pas gzhan rnams kyi phyogs mtshams kyang shes par bya zhing / rdo rje'i pho nya mo rnams la mu khyud kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshan ma brgyad brgyad bya ba ni mdun du bzhi dang rgyab tu bzhi byas pas gral rim la ma shongs dgos mod cing / nyi ma gling pa'i zin bris ltar da lta gong dkar na phyag len la'ang 'di yod/ gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing la/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig kyang bshams la bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po brgyad la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byugs/ de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshang can kha dog dkar po bya/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bshams/ rang g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas/ /yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur wa ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham/ /rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ /ku sha'i 'thor yab/ rdo rje dril bu nang gi mchod pa rnams bsham/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag

so sor bzhag na bar chad kyi chos yin gsung / grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa'ang bshams shing / 'di med na 'jig rten pa'i me lha spyan drangs tshar ba'i rjes su phyir 'brangs bgegs bskrad byed dgos/ rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lngas gtor la bzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni phyi ma red kyi dus su rang nyid khrus byas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas te skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/

zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying gar bzung dril bu rgyun dkrol dang rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ri ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma hrīḥd ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis/ /brkyangs te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ /khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi /thur du blugs pa bdug pa'i 'o/ /mthe bong gyen bsgreng mar me ste/ /thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtogs pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞

zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba de yang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu de yang rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang ba mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa/ khog pa stong pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus dang phyogs bcur paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ dbus su tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng du nyi zla/ 'og tu sa bdag phag rnams kyi gdan dang bcas par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rab tu gdangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer cung zad bsdus shing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas thugs kar bzhugs pas bdag nyid kyi lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ bcu las khro bo bcur gyur te thugs ka nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ byang du rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che nag po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/

/yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ drug cu rtsa bzhi las rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhir gyur pa thugs ka nas phyir spros/ rtsibs kyi phyi rol gyi mu khyud la phyogs mtshams brgyad du brgyad brgyad 'khod pa ni/ shar du kyai rdo rje ma/ don yod rdo rje ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje bde bar 'gro ma/ rdo rje 'jigs par byed ma/ rdo rje las thams cad ma/ rdo rje thugs thams cad ma/ rdo rje sdig par 'joms par byed ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rdo rje bum pa ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje don grub ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje dam tshig ma/ ku ru ku rdo rje ma/ rdo rje pra ba ri ma/ rdo rje dbang byed ma rnams sku mdog g.yas dkar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ rdo rje rmongs byed ma/ rdo rje mgrin byed ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags 'ching ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags phyir gsol ma/ rdo rje 'gengs ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje mig sman ma rnams sku mdog ser mo g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rdo rje sgrub pa mo/ rdo rje bsrung ba ma/ rdo rje don byed ma/ rdo rje lte ba ma/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ rdo rje snying rje'i zhags pa ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ rdo rje mgyogs ma rnams sku mdog g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu rdo rje len pa ma/ rdo rje thams cad 'phrog ma/ rdo rje blags ma/ rdo rje ri khrod ma/ rdo rje bsnun ma/ rdo rje mdzes pa'i snyim pa ma/ rdo rje me tog snyim pa ma/ rdo rje theg pa ma rnams sku mdog dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rdo rje gdon dang rims kyis thebs su 'jug ma/ rdo rje byed pa ma/ rdo rje blo gros ma/ rdo rje sgra ma/ rdo rje khro ba ma/ rdo rje gnas mdzes ma/ rdo rje gtum mo/ rdo rje sbyin pa mo rnams sku mdog g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa/

byang du rdo rje shing lo ma/ rdo rje nges par gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje gtsug tor ma/ rdo rje phur bu ma/ rdo rje smra ba ma/ rdo rje dgod ma/ rdo rje mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ rdo rje spyan drangs ma rnams sku mdog ljang khu g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du rdo rje rab grub ma/ rdo rje dga' bar byed ma/ rdo rje rang byung ma/ rdo rje thub pa ma/ ngag gi rdo rje ma/ rdo rje dbang byed ma/ rdo rje thig le ma/ rdo rje bsrung ba ma sku mdog g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas lte ba mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa lha bdun cu rtsa lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ chu bzhi nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ bet+ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra ni ri nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ nas/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/

sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i khro bo dgu la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje pho nya mo shar dang byang shar ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ shar lho ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub phyogs pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ nub byang dang byang phyogs pa rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas la bzlas pa ni/ lha'i sku la dmigs te/ nye snying gi gtso bo'i sngags/ snying po khro bo bcu/ rtsa sngags rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi sngags su gsungs pas go rim de ltar lan 'ga' bzlas shing / rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba/ rdo rje snying pos rab tu smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/

rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du bcug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung bar byed pa/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so/ /na mo rat+na tra ā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghur+ṇā ghur+ṇā/ ghur+ṇā pa ya ghur+ṇā pa ya/ sarba satwa ni/ bo dha bo dha/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū ta ni/ ku ṭa ku ṭa/ saṅku ṭa ya saṅku ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūṃ nan/ gha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya/ sang ghā ṭa ya sang ghā ṭa ya/ sarba bid+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ a ṭa ha sa ni la badz+ra/ su badz+rā ya swāhā/ he phu lu/ ni ru phu lu/ grih+ṇa ku lu/ mi li tsu lu/ ku ru ku lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swāhā/ ki li ki lā ya swāhā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na/ pra mo ṭa nā ya swāhā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ma ra ma ra/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa ya swāhā/ ts+tshan+da ts+tshan+da/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ ma hā ki li ki lā ya swāhā/ ban+dha ban+dha/ kro dha ki li ki la ya swāhā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsan+ḍa ki li ki lā ya swāhā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swāhā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha ra ya swāhā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhan dza nā ya swāhā/ ma tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ shu tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ pra tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shi gh+raṃ badz+rā ya swāhā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba ku lan ā warta ya swāhā/ a muṃ kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ban/ badz+ra ba len ā warta ya/

ma hā badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ ka ta be/ ta ta be/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la ma ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra na/ a dzi ti/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ tiṃ ga le/ da ha da ha/ de wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dz+wa la ya swāhā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ du na du na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dha ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra phaṭa/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+da ban+da/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par mdzad/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /sems can dbang po nyams pa dang / /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang / /phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang / /lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / /mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang / /bram ze la sogs gtses pa dang / /phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang / /nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang / /mya ngan ngal las gnod pa dang / /'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stims dang / /mi zad gdon gyis nyan pa dang / /mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi/ /rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang / /des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yi/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ /gang dag yid dge sems dngas shing / /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi/ /mi bzad pa yi nad rnams dang / /de dag thams cad zhi bar blta/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /nor bu nyung kar ngur ba dang / /rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas/ /shel dang rdo rje me tog dang / /chu yi gser ram yang na ni/

/dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung / /gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkris shing dgang / /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas su/ /rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /ces pa ste/ gleng bzhi lan cig dang / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs rgyud kyi rim pa ltar ci nus su bzlas te/ mjug tu phan yon dran pa lan cig brjod/ yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams nye snying dang swā bhā was bsangs sbyangs byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gong gi mtshan sngags la oṃ ā hūm̐ btags pas bdud rtsi phul/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud rwa gur la/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ de rdo rje pho nya mo rnams la/ de khro bo bcu la/ de gtso bo la thim/ 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me spar te yam shing mar la sbags pa'am rtsa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing ngag tu/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa sogs nye snying lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/

de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la nye snying ngam hūm̐ ring po 'ga' zhig brjod pas rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags de gnyis gang rung brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang gtor byas te bgegs bsal la/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dz+ri swāhās 'bru/ oṃ swa swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā zhes sogs mchod pa rnams kyang so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs 'di 'og tu bshad kyang phyag len la 'dir mdzad pa cho ga zor yang ba'i ched yin no/ /bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ kha khyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/

/lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'am/ yang na phyag bzhi pa g.yas mchod sbyin dang bgrang phreng / g.yon dbyug gu dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā da ka ma hā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi dwi dza pa ta ma/ gri hi twa ā hū tiṃ ā ha ra/ a smin san ni hi to bha wa zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod la thab tu me tog gcig phul te thab kyi shar lhor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi phul la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcing ba'am/ spos dang bcas pas dril bu bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa dri sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs bzhi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'am/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga ghan+dhe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ blos khob chung bas gong du ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar la skabs 'dir dngos su sbar ro zhes gsung yang lag len snga ma bde'o/ /de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes brjod/ de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas bskor du bkram mo/

/de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pyā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swāhā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ /de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ bar der me'i pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pas bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rig pas shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swāhās 'bras so ba dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhās 'bras dang / oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhās nas dang / oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swāhās gro dang / oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swāhās sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhās dur wa dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swāhās/

ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro/ /go rim 'di rnams bsreg rdzas shom pa'i skabs su gsungs pa'i go rim bzhin byas pa yin pas de'i skabs su bshad pa'i sdom tshig blo la nges pa gal che'o/ /de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang / oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil phul la mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes pa nas/ 'og tu sa bdag phag rnams kyi gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhes pa nas snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur zhes pa'i bar dang / de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las khro bo bcur gyur te phyogs bcu'i gdan gyi steng du 'khor ba ni zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ spro na spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing /

/zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ e h+ye hi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya artsa ma naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza no pa tsar+ya pra sid+dhi me zhes brjod la/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod la/ dgug gzhug nas bzung dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi bar thams cad bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ 'on kyang khro bo brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gtso bo la rnam par snang mdzad/ rdo rje'i pho nya mo shar dang / zhes sogs 'dra'o/ /lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chu gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa sogs nye snying lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pyā dī pyā zhes sogs kyi mthar bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ skabs 'dir mchod bstod rgyas par byed par bshad kyang phyag len la gong bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu bshad pa ltar phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa'i mchod pa tsam mdzad pas lag len de bde'o/ /de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar nye snying tshar gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa phul la logs nas sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung /

bsnyen pa kha gso la sogs pa'i dus su nub re la til stong phrag lnga'am khri la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa 'bul zhing skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa phul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang 'jug go /de la yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha thams cad kyi zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo/ /bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te phyi'i mchod pa rnams 'bul ba ni/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra zhes sogs brjod cing / phyag rgya bkrol te rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gtogs/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi thog mtha' dang phyag rgya rnams 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/

/sogs gong bzhin las/ dhū paṃ/ srin po 'joms 'di dag byed la/ /dges shing mun pa rnams sel ba/ /ā lo ke/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid dgar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /nai wa d+ye/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bdag gi sogs dang / shap+ta'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol du byas te/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis na bza' blangs te thog mar smad g.yogs dang / de nas stod g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / lha re re la phul bar bsam mo/ /mdun gyi nang mchod nye snying dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor gu las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta yi sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dzīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/

lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod nas blangs te mthe bos rtses gtor la lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsams shing / ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/

mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod la/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ skyor ston dri med dpal/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba rab 'byor zla ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa nas/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na mo rat+na nas/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na mo rat+na nas/ aṅku sha dz+wa la ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa lha bdun cu rtsa lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud bran la/ de nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ dharma pa la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du༞ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du༞ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du༞ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du༞ bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du༞ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes brjod rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang dril bu gsil la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyas pa pad+mo yi/ /snying po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'gyings pa'i tshul gyis legs bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dpal la 'dud/ /sna tshogs phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sku mdog margad ltar gsal ba/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par spras/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa dang / /dpa' dang brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis/ /nyid kyi thugs kar bsgyings nas bsnams/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ /rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rig sngags nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug sgra stong bzhin rnams bsgrags pas/ /bdud dpung ma lus rnam gnon cing / /'dod dgu sbyin par mdzad la 'dud/ /khyod thugs zab pas nyer zhi yang / /rgya che rol pas kun khyab mdzad/ /mi g.yo kun 'gro rtag brtan pa/ /ye shes dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan phrin las rin chen gyi/ /mi zad gter gyur mgon khyod la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs kyis/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes gtso bstod dang / khro bcu dang rdo rje'i pho nya mo la bstod pa byed par spro na kho bos brtsams pa'i zur gsal bzhin no/ /gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ sngags ring tshar gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gi mchod bstod bsdus pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo byed na mtshams 'dir bya/ mi byed na thal mo sbyar te/

mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi rjes la grub na gur nas bshad pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas te mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bkus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes la/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang / /'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang / /las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no/ /dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar bdag gam yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shis pa dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/

zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o/ /gnyis pa me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa ni drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba gang ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad bsgyur te yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhās bsang gtor dang / oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ne swāhās 'thor 'thung phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyis gshegs/ /ji srid dus su slar gshegs te/

/bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ zhes dang / dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam la/ gnas gsum bsrungs bsngo smon bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /drug pa ni mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na/ me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi 'jug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blos gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gong ma'i gsung rab dang / de'i gsal byed she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor sgrub dkyil rnams la gzhi brten nas shin tu dag par sbyar ba 'di la nor 'khrul med snyam yang / bdag blo rmongs pas 'gal 'khrul gyi cha mchis tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags shing / 'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag thams cad zhi nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig/ ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra bi dā ra ya/ 'dir rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i lugs rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos su mdzad pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bstod thung bstod ring gi rnam gzhag cung zad 'dri na/ bstod pa thung ba ni/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus/

/bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi drag po'i sku/ /phyogs bcur phrin las sna tshogs sgrub mdzad pa/ /phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms yang sprul pho nya mo/ /rdo rje'i ming can phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du/ /rdo rje'i lus can brgyad brgyad drug cu bzhi/ /rdo rje'i las mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / bstod ring ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ nas/ bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo bar 'dra/ de nang gser 'khor rtsibs bcu'i dbus/ /pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan steng du/ /'gying bag rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dpal la 'dud/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'bar ba phyag g.yas kyi/ /nyid kyi thugs kar 'gying zhing bsnams/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gzhan bstod rnying sor bzhag steng du 'khor lo sgyur ba ni/ /gser gyi mdog can 'khor lo 'dzin/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /steng gdon 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar du gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dbang sngon mdog can tho ba 'dzin/ /pad nyi brgya byin gdan la bzhugs/ /dri za 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs shes rab mthar byed ni/ /dung mdog rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin/ /pad nyi ya ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed ni/ /nyi ma'i mdog can pad dmar 'dzin/ /pad nyi chu bdag gdan la bzhugs/ /klu gdon 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang du rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag /rdor dril rang gi phyag rgyas 'dzin/ /pad nyi nor bdag gdan la bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar mi g.yo mgon po ni/ /char sprin mdog mtshungs ral gri 'dzin/ /pad nyi bgegs bdag gdan la bzhugs/ /dbang ldan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/

/shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /mthing nag rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin/ /pad nyi byin za'i gdan la bzhugs/ /me lha 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /nam mkha'i mdog can dbyug sngon 'dzin/ /pad nyi srin po'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bden bral 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang ma hā ba la ni/ /mig sman mdog can rtse gsum 'dzin/ /pad nyi rig 'dzin gdan la bzhugs/ /rlung lha 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po ni/ /uta sngon mdog mtshungs gtun shing 'dzin/ /pad nyi sa bdag gdan la bzhugs/ /'og gdon 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra smin ma sma ra 'bar/ /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad la bstod/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /me dpung dbus na bzhugs la bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs pa'i/ /dam tshig can kun bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bka' bsgos pho nya rnams la bstod/ /gang dag phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru/ /dkar ser dmar ljang phyed gzugs can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /brkyang bskum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo rin chen pad ral dang / /mig 'bras kyis mtshan 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje ut+pal g.yas na 'dzin/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad la bstod/ /dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i rnam rol gyis/ /bsgrub la chu tshod drug cu bzhi'i/ /bar chad thams cad srung la bstod/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor la/ /bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos legs mchod pas/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms nyid gyur cig /ces rnam 'joms bir lugs lha bdun cu rtsa lnga la bstod pa 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o//
